product_identity.name: Anclora Purgedoc
product_identity.core_purpose: Desktop-first document redaction & privacy application with accessible review interface, native PDF and DOCX support, local NER/regex detection, synchronized viewer with bounding boxes, real content purge, automated fail-closed post-purge verification, and cryptographic audit reports.
product_identity.tone_and_voice: Sober, high-trust, institutional, precise Spanish/English bilingual compliance tool.

header_controls_spec.language_toggle: Pill button format with ES / EN switcher, subtle border, smooth background slide animation.
header_controls_spec.theme_toggle: Circular button with dark navy background #0E1525-#101828, 1-1.5px blue-cyan border #3B82F6-#38BDF8, soft glow drop-shadow, text/icon color #F5F7FA.
header_controls_spec.logo_space: Reserved left-hand slot (w-40 h-8 flex items-center) with placeholder slot '[ANCLORA PURGEDOC]' for future brand asset.
header_controls_spec.qa_fixture_loader: Development mode toggle button with test fixtures loader (preset HR, Legal, Tech Support documents).

layout_and_key_screens.desktop_first_policy: Optimized split-view layout for desktop screens (>1024px) while providing stacked tabs and collapsible drawers for tablet/mobile viewports.

screens.title: Document Upload & Profile Selection
screens.description: Drag & drop upload zone supporting PDF and DOCX files paired with vertical profile selector cards.

profiles.detects: DNI/NIE, SSN, IBAN, Full Names, Salaries, Phone numbers
Confidentiality clauses, Corporate Tax IDs (CIF), Signatures, Addresses, Trade Secrets
IP Addresses, API Keys, Passwords, Access Tokens, Internal Hostnames, MAC Addresses

screens.title: Document Processing Stepper
screens.description: Real multi-stage processing tracker with live log stream.

screens.title: Interactive Redaction Review Workspace
screens.layout: 2-column split layout (60% Document Viewer Canvas, 40% Matches Review Panel)
document_viewer_features: Native canvas viewer with zoom controls (50% - 200%) and page navigation
Synchronized interactive bounding box overlays matching detected entities
Click bounding box on canvas to highlight corresponding review card
Manual Redaction Tool: Draw custom bounding boxes for custom text/area masking
review_panel_features: Match cards grouped by Entity Type (DNI, IBAN, Name, IP, API Key, etc.)
Confidence score badges (e.g., 98% Confidence, Regex Rule vs Spacy NER)
Status indicator (Pending, Approved for Purge, Excluded/Preserved)
Filter controls: Filter by Status, Entity Type, Page Number, Confidence Score
Bulk Actions: 'Accept All High Confidence', 'Reject All', 'Select Range'
Keyboard shortcuts (A = Accept, R = Reject, N = Next, P = Prev)

screens.title: Irreversible Purge Confirmation Modal
screens.description: Dialog warning user about permanent content removal vs visual overlays, showing exact count of entities to be destroyed.

screens.title: Real Content Purge & Fail-Closed Post-Verification Screen
screens.description: Flattens PDF/DOCX streams, strips metadata & hidden text layers, then runs automated fail-closed scanner.
outcomes: Pass: Displays green 'Verificado Post-Purga / Purge Verified' badge and SHA-256 fingerprint.
Fail-Closed: Displays red high-priority alert if residual PII text is detected in the stream, locking export until manually resolved.

dev_fixture_loader.button_label: Cargar Datos de Prueba / Load Test Fixtures
test_fixtures: Sample HR Payroll PDF (NIF, IBAN, Salary)
Sample Legal Service Agreement DOCX (CIF, Signatures, Addresses)
Sample Server Log File (IPs, API Tokens, Hostnames)

testing_and_fixtures.data_testid_policy: EVERY interactive element, state display, modal, and action trigger MUST have explicit data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

accessibility_requirements.contrast_ratio: Minimum 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text & active borders
accessibility_requirements.keyboard_nav: Full tab order support, visible focus rings (ring-2 ring-blue-500 ring-offset-2)
accessibility_requirements.aria: Proper aria-expanded on modals, aria-live='polite' for real-time stepper updates, aria-selected on profiles.

curated_image_assets.description: Document Security & Privacy Compliance Document Stack
curated_image_assets.usage: Background/hero illustration for sample document workspace

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the React / Tailwind CSS stack in JS format.
Implement language state (ES/EN) and theme switcher (Dark default) using React Context or standard state.
Ensure Header follows exact button styling: Pill language button, Circular dark-navy theme button with cyan glow.
Build real state machine for Document processing (Upload -> Processing Stepper -> Review Workspace -> Modal Confirmation -> Purge Processing -> Final Results).
Include dev mode fixture loader button so QA can test with preset mock documents instantly.
Attach data-testid to every interactive component listed in required_test_ids.
